goal:
T56 — evolution stats panel on the replay screen (v3.8 §9: show measured values, never a win without evidence).
Web only; data from GET /v1/evolution/stats (T55): {runs, comparison: evoforge_better|single_better|not_significant,
method, by_side: {evoforge|single: {rounds, verified, wilson95: [lo, hi], cost_cents, cost_per_verified_cents|null}}}.
1. apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts: statsView(stats) -> null for null input, else {runs, verdict (= stats.comparison, never
   computed on the client), evoforge: V, single: V} with V = {verified "k/n", rate "P%" (Math.round(100k/n)) or "—" when
   n == 0, interval "L–H%" (en dash; Math.round of lo*100 and hi*100) or "—" when n == 0, costPerVerified "N¢" or "—"}.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: getEvolutionStats(feedback?) -> GET /v1/evolution/stats.
3. apps/web/components/EvolutionStats.tsx: two side cards (verified, rate, interval bar, cost per verified round), the
   verdict as a label (not significant shown prominently when that is the verdict), number of runs and the method note.
4. Show it on apps/web/app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx above the run list.
5. i18n "replay" (en + ko): stats-title, stats-runs, stats-not-significant, stats-evoforge-better, stats-single-better,
   stats-method (plus labels you add).
Keep tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t56.py.
